idea-plugin.name: Manage Keymap Conflicts
idea-plugin.description:
Find and resolve keyboard-shortcut conflicts in your macOS keymaps — shortcuts that clash with macOS system shortcuts, and duplicate bindings within a keymap. A live, grouped report explains each overlap (whether your IDE still wins the key or macOS takes it first) and lets you rebind or remove the shortcut in place, or export and import keymaps as XML to share them. Open it any time from Tools → Manage Keymap Conflicts… or Find Action.

It also bundles the MacBook Pro DE keymap as a ready-made starting point: a macOS keymap tuned for MacBook Pro keyboards with the German (T1) layout, avoiding shortcuts that are physically unpressable there (keys like / = ; ' ` [ ] are only Shift/Option chords on that layout, and there is no numpad or Insert key). Select it under Settings → Keymap.

macOS-focused: the conflict scan reads the JetBrains Runtime's live system-shortcut table (the same source as the IDE's own conflict banner).

Source code: github.com/stefan-huettemann/manage-keymap-conflicts
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Conflict report with per-conflict advice, in-place rebind/remove, and XML export.
  • Import a keymap from XML (gear menu → Import…): validates the file, resolves a name clash, and lets you pick a parent when the file's declared parent isn't installed. Imported keymaps can be deleted again.
  • Bundled MacBook Pro DE keymap for the German (T1) MacBook Pro layout.
  • Report wording adapts to the host IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, Android Studio, …).

action.description: Manage a keymap's shortcut conflicts with macOS and within the keymap
